launchNotice.title: Calculeat launches Premium 🎉
launchNotice.body:
Thank you so much for helping test Calculeat!

We are now launching for real, and with it comes Premium (45 kr/month or 399 kr/year with a 7-day free trial). Your account has moved to the free tier.

All your data is still there — but content above the free tier limits (e.g. more than 3 recipes or history older than 30 days) is locked until you upgrade. Everything unlocks again instantly if you go Premium.

Questions? Reach out in the support chat!
